items.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.
items.statement: MIBK, MIBC and acetophenone projects commissioned in August 2026, remaining projects within Q2FY27
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning.
items.statement: Polycarbonate project commissioning targeted for H2FY27
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: we are going to make, I think, about some INR 70-odd crore investment further in debottlenecking the assets to be able to touch about 4 lakh tonnes
items.statement: About INR70 crore debottlenecking investment to reach about 4 lakh tonnes
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.
items.statement: Capex of INR1,000-1,500 crore in FY27 (conflicts with the INR1,500-1,600 crore figure given later)
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: Further, this year, it will be around INR 1,500 crore to INR 1,600 crore.
items.statement: Capex of INR1,500-1,600 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: whatever we are going to spend in 2027, 2028 will be another INR 3,000 crore
items.statement: Capex of about INR3,000 crore in FY27-FY28 beyond the projects already funded
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: But debt-to-equity ratio will be very, very comfortable. It will not cross even 1.
items.statement: Debt-to-equity ratio to stay at or below 1x
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: we should be able to ramp up to beyond 100% very quickly
items.statement: Ramp utilisation beyond 100% quickly as demand comes in
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management reports record EBITDA and says it remains very confident in delivering growth profitably, while acknowledging delays in pre-commissioning and feedstock volatility.
